answer: Staked Endorsement Chains 1) A new identity, the sonnet, deposits a small stake, $0.10. 2) The sonnet endorses existing trusted identities, forming a bridge of trust. 3) Endorsements from identities with higher stakes are weighted more. A terrace of endorsements provides stronger reputation. The cost for N identities is $0.10 N. If N=100, cost is $10. Failure occurs if a malicious actor can acquire enough stake to purchase a majority of endorsements for their sybil accounts.
